runSummary.note: Full diversity sweep on 9.9.2026 10:53 across 10 independent source families, 9 outside Profesia. No new promotion-grade unique job was found. Profesia re-surfaced Tatra Supercompute L1 Service Desk in Bratislava, but explicit English B2 plus onsite 24/7 three-shift operation remains a strong mismatch. LinkedIn surfaced Wolt Support Associate Part Time in Bratislava, but student/shift-heavy support is below preferred fit and is already a known reject. Worki returned an inactive e-shop admin and an older low-value part-time administration role. Kariera returned Bratislava customer-support results but no new superior canonical delta. Pretlak returned Stretchfit Creative Strategist and StartupJobs returned Aukro HU Account Manager; both are outside profile due senior creative scope or Hungarian-market language burden. Upwork returned worldwide WooCommerce/e-commerce admin and WordPress work; the best operational hit was E-Commerce Operations & Admin VA at 250 USD fixed, but advanced Excel plus 15-20 proposals and unclear effective rate keep it below LIVE. Reddit results were FOR HIRE providers rather than hiring demand. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.
